lid_modes.how: Full metal/plastic screw-off lid on the threaded bottle mouth; remove entire lid to drink or pour.
Separate plastic flip/hinge pour lid that sits on its own seat — not a spout molded onto the screw threads.

forbid: do not invent a plastic pour spout or flip lid opening directly on the metal screw threads
do not mix screw mouth and flip spout into a hybrid that does not exist on the real product
do not redesign the mouth diameter or add a straw/button not in the references
immutable.colors: Matte black body; lid finish as in refs; no chrome redesign.
immutable.proportions: Tall slim bottle; cup/lid height similar to refs; keep silhouette.

notes: If a shot needs 'steam from open lid', specify which lid_mode id is open; never invent a third mechanism.
